page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top with page number at top left. Below the text, at the right, a bare number "15.".

main_text.p: gistratui indicet, qui secus statuunt: Improbamus, inquit, & illos qui auctoritatem in Religione DICIS TANTUM CAUSSA attribuunt Magistratibus &c. dum illos aliud esse nolunt, quàm eorum, quæ ab Episcopis definiuntur exequutores. Vide de hac propositione Confessionem Ecclesiarum Gallicarum art. 39. 40. Anglicam art. 37. Belgicam art. 36, Bohemicam art. 16. Calvinum Instit. lib. IV. cap. 11. §. 16. Bullingerum de Episcoporum institutione & functione cap. 1. Petrum Martyrem in 1. Sam. cap. 8. de quo commentario Iofias Simlerus Theologus Tigurinus in præfatione ait: nihil eum continere quod non Orthodoxum sit. Eundem in locis communibus lib. 4. c. 13. & in Appendice locorum communium Quæstione, Regi, Principi, Magistratui, liceatne de Religione statuere? Bucerum lib. 1. de Regno Christi. Iuellum Episcopum Sarisburiensem in Apolog. Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ capp. 9. 10. 11. 12. 13.14.

page.notes: The section sign at the top right ("§. I.") is a printed header element, not part of the running head; it is left out. The "15." at the lower right is a bare number and is written as a paragraph. "attribuunt" is printed as "attrbuunt" (with an omitted vowel) in the scan; it is read here as "attribuunt" but may be a printing error. The text is set in roman with italic passages and small capitals for "DICIS TANTUM CAUSSA"; the print is slightly blurred around "Ecclesiarum" and "Magistratibus".
